name: Raum

subjectOf.text: Revised Form ADV requires advisers to report gross rather than net regulatory assets under management and narrows their discretion to include or exclude assets, so the registration threshold becomes harder to manage down through reporting choices.
subjectOf.abstract: To increase consistency, revised Form ADV also gives investment advisers less room to exercise discretion in counting or excluding assets from RAUM.115
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2150377
scope_conditions: advisers filing the November 2011 revised Form ADV

subjectOf.text: Regulatory assets under management is an unstable reporting concept: commenters split evenly on whether Form PF's RAUM questions required them to interpret the term in order to answer.
subjectOf.abstract: Commenters were equally split on whether Form PF questions pertaining to calculating RAUM required filers to interpret RAUM for purposes of completing Form PF.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

subjectOf.text: The Form PF definition of Regulatory Assets under Management is the leading example of a definition that forced filers to interpret what they were required to report.
subjectOf.abstract: Especially the definition of Regulatory Assets under Management (RAUM), as required by Form PF, required filers to interpret what they were required to report.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2470008

subjectOf.text: Form PF instructions need clarification and its definitions, including those for RAUM and AUM, need improvement, since there is evidence that questions and definitions had to be optimized.
subjectOf.abstract: There is also evidence that Form PF questions and definitions had to be optimized, including performance information required by Form PF.177 Form PF instructions generally needs clarification and the definitions for RAUM/AUM in Form PF, among others, have to be improved.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2470008

subjectOf.text: Because the FSOC uses RAUM related valuations directly and indirectly to set stage one thresholds, and because RAUM requires substantial filer interpretation, it is questionable whether the FSOC can use that Form PF data effectively and sustainably for systemic risk evaluations and SIFI designations.
subjectOf.abstract: it seems at least questionable if FSOC will be able to use the related Form PF data effectively and sustainably for its systemic risk evaluations and the designation of non-bank financial companies as systemically risky
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2470008
scope_conditions: stage one thresholds computed from RAUM related asset valuations

subjectOf.text: The SEC estimates that 230 U.S. hedge fund advisers with at least $1.5 billion in RAUM attributable to hedge funds at the end of any month in the prior fiscal quarter will file Form PF.
subjectOf.abstract: The SEC estimates that 230 U.S. hedge fund advisers with at least $1.5 billion in RAUM attributable to hedge funds at the end of any month in the prior fiscal quarter will file Form PF.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2732915
scope_conditions: SEC estimate in the Form PF adopting release

subjectOf.text: A single point in time RD design anchored to March 30, 2012 is inadequate on its own because advisers could and did register before the deadline, funds near the $150 million threshold could choose between registered adviser and exempt reporting adviser status, and self-reported Morningstar AUM is not calculated the same way as the SEC's RAUM.
subjectOf.abstract: Fourth, the self-reported assets under management numbers in Morningstar are not calculated the same way as the RAUM calculation required by the SEC.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2816408
scope_conditions: broad RD design in Part IV

subjectOf.text: Several core Form PF questions that feed the FSOC's stage one threshold assessment are defective, most importantly because the definition of RAUM required substantive interpretation by the filers themselves.
subjectOf.abstract: Several core Form PF questions that provide specific information for FSOC's stage one threshold assessment encounter problems. More specifically, the definition of RAUM required substantive interpretation by filers.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016 (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998097
scope_conditions: Form PF valuation questions tied to RAUM
